chunks: Ja'far ibn Muhammad ibn Masrur (may God have mercy on him) narrated to us, he said: al-Husayn ibn Muhammad ibn Amer narrated to us, from his uncle Abdullah ibn Amer, he said: Abu Ahmad Muhammad ibn Ziyad al-Azdi narrated to me, from Aban ibn Uthman al-Ahmar, from Aban ibn Taghlib, from Ikrimah, from Ibn Abbas, he said: The Messenger of God (may God bless him and his family) said to Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon him) one day, while he was in the mosque of Quba and the Ansar were gathered:

O Ali, you are my brother and I am your brother. O Ali, you are my deputy, my vicegerent, and the Imam of my nation after me. God aligns with whoever befriends you, God is the enemy of whoever is your enemy, God hates whoever hates you, God supports whoever supports you, and God abandons whoever abandons you. O Ali, you are the husband of my daughter and the father of my descendants. O Ali, when I was taken up to the heavens, my Lord promised me three things regarding you. He said: O Muhammad! I said: I am at Your service, my Lord, blessed and exalted are You. Then He said: Ali is the Imam of the Godfearing, the Leader of the shining believers, and the Chief of the believers.

key_terms.إمام المتقين: Imam of the Godfearing — a divine title indicating spiritual leadership
key_terms.خليفة: Khalifa (vicegerent/successor) — the legitimate political and spiritual successor
key_terms.قائد الغر المحجلين: Leader of the shining believers — those whose faces and limbs will shine on the Day of Judgment from ablution
key_terms.وصي: Wasi (deputy/executor) — the designated religious successor who carries out the Prophet's testament
key_terms.يعسوب المؤمنين: Chief of the believers — ya'sub literally means the queen bee, the leader around whom others gather

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet say about Ali in the mosque of Quba?
ai.summary: The Prophet (SAWW) publicly declared Ali ibn Abi Talib's (AS) supreme status before the Ansar at the Mosque of Quba, addressing him as brother, deputy, vicegerent, and Imam after him. He announced divine alignment with Ali's friends and divine enmity toward his enemies. Most significantly, during the Mi'raj (Night Ascension), God Himself proclaimed three titles for Ali: Imam of the Godfearing, Leader of the shining believers (ghurr al-muhajjalin), and Chief (ya'sub) of the believers.

en.bilal-muhammad: Ja`far b. Muhammad b. Masrur (rh) narrated to us. He said: Al-Husayn b. Muhammad b. `Amer narrated to us from his uncle `Abdullah b. `Amer. He said: Abu Ahmad Muhammad b. Ziyad al-Azdi narrated to me from Aban b. `Uthman al-Ahmar from Aban b. Taghlub from `Ikrama from Ibn `Abbas. He said: The Messenger of Allah (s) said to `Ali b. Abi Talib (as) – and they were gathered with the Ansar in the Quba Mosque on that day:

O `Ali! You are my brother, and I am your brother. O `Ali! You are my deputy, my vicegerent (khalifa), and the Imam of my Nation after me. Allah aligns with those who align with you, and Allah is the enemy of those who are an enemy to you. Allah hates those who hate you, Allah supports those who support you, and Allah abandons those who abandon you. O `Ali! You are the spouse of my daughter and the father of my descendants. O `Ali! Surely, when I was taken up to heaven, my Lord promised me three things regarding you. He said to me: “O Muhammad!” I said: “I am here at Your service, my Lord, may You be glorified and exalted.” So, He said: Surely, `Ali is the Imam of the Godfearing, the Leader of the shining believers, and the Chief of the believers.
